description: React component for the 'Performance Debugging' section in user settings, including collapsed and expanded views with preference toggles and save functionality.

classes.name: PerformanceDebuggingSectionCollapsed
classes.description: A React component that displays a collapsed view of the performance debugging settings, showing the number of enabled options.

methods.name: PerformanceDebuggingSection
methods.description: Main React component managing the performance debugging section, toggling between expanded and collapsed views based on props.

methods.name: PerformanceDebuggingSectionExpanded
methods.description: Component rendering the expanded view with checkboxes to enable/disable performance debugging options and save preferences.
